instructions_to_main_agent: Use React JS with React Router DOM v7 (defined in package.json). Ensure routing supports: '/', '/create', '/preview/:id', '/confirmation/:id', '/admin', '/terms', '/privacy', '/contact'.
Keep the aesthetic clean, bright (fond clair), airy, with generous whitespace (py-16 to py-24 on sections, p-8 on cards).
Do not use dark gradients across entire pages. Use pure #FAFAFA background with clean white cards, 1px subtle borders (#E2E8F0), and prominent rounded corners (rounded-2xl).

Buttons must have high contrast and clear visual hierarchy: Primary dark CTAs (bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800) with rounded-xl or rounded-full, and secondary light buttons (bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-50).

Include simulated realistic face-swap pipeline with a dynamic multi-step progress bar (0% to 100%) that cycles through realistic AI logs: Landmark detection, face alignment, neural blend, preview encoding.
Provide ready-to-use sample video clips and preset faces so users can test immediately in 1 click without requiring them to prepare MP4/PNG files on their machine.

Preview page must display a realistic player with a subtle overlay watermark ('PREVIEW GRATUITE - QUALITÉ RÉDUITE') and prominent unlock card highlighting 'Télécharger en HD 4K sans filigrane - 4,99€'.
Simulate Stripe modal with realistic test cards and mock checkout flow, automatically directing to confirmation page on success.
Admin dashboard must have interactive Recharts graphs, filtering on transactions, simulated download links, and revenue summaries.
Include Sonner toast notifications on all copy, upload, and payment triggers.
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, and card has explicit data-testid attributes according to the data_testid_strategy.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: 2-3x generous spacing. Do not cram cards or text.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.contrast: Always respect WCAG AA text contrast. High contrast on hover and active states.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.animations: Subtle Framer Motion entrance transitions and smooth tab changes. Avoid heavy full-screen blocking animations.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.header_nav: Sticky header with backdrop blur bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-100, visible links on desktop, mobile dropdown on mobile.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.footer: Crisp slate footer with legal links, language indicator, and secure payment badges (Stripe, SSL).
